description: When a held bill expires (POS-08: "held bills expire at day close", owner answer 4 to W1-12): once its business day is over, at the next day's 04:00 cutoff in the tenant's time zone (D-056). Asia/Karachi is UTC+5, so 04:00 local is 23:00 UTC the day before. Expired = the business date now is after the held bill's.

cases.name: 03:59 the next morning: still the same business day
held at 23:50, ten past midnight: not yet (the day ends at 04:00, not at midnight)
a held bill dated after now (the PC's clock was set back) is kept
